fields.subject: SQL Server Provider Package
fields.trigger: when ArgentSea.Sql.csproj is built or restored
fields.response: the project composes the Microsoft.Data.SqlClient-specific completion of the core database-provider seam by declaring, unconditionally and without any build-configuration or platform Condition, both a PackageReference on Microsoft.Data.SqlClient and a ProjectReference on ArgentSea.Shared (the core ArgentSea abstractions)
fields.postcondition: every build and restore of ArgentSea.Sql.csproj requires both Microsoft.Data.SqlClient and ArgentSea.Shared; the project file conditions neither reference on configuration or platform
